body.heading: Let the crayon dance
paragraphs: Choose a song with your adult. When it plays, move your crayon the way the music feels.
Fast music might make zigzags. Slow music might make long, sleepy waves.

body.heading: Change the song
paragraphs: Try a very different song on a new page. Loud parts can be big marks; quiet parts can be tiny dots.
Hold both pictures up. Can your family guess which song was which?

takeaway: Music you can see is wavy, spiky, swirly, and full of colour.
safetyNotes: Keep the music at a gentle volume so ears stay comfortable.
screenFreeExtension: Draw the sound of rain, a lullaby, and a marching band, and compare the three pictures.
